strategy.offer: Prescription and over-the-counter medicines, a broad generics range, health information, and contract development and manufacturing services for pharmaceutical products.
strategy.customers: Physicians, pharmacies, patients, health insurers, and other pharmaceutical companies needing development, manufacturing, quality, validation, and regulatory support.
strategy.why_we_win: Its reasoning is that independence enables faster decisions and flexibility, while portfolio expansion, high quality, and trusted customer relationships secure long-term success.
strategy.resources: Experienced employees, in-house manufacturing and development, modern production and analytical technology, strong quality-control capabilities, and long pharmaceutical industry experience.
strategy.direction: Further internationalization, capacity expansion, and continuous broadening of the portfolio with new prescription and consumer health products.
